rule.supported: Every named verbatim member completes with output and model-payload parity in both lanes under shipped code; models use the router and data uses the broker.
rule.alternative: If support fails, every verbatim member tidy-refuses in both lanes or runs outside the bridge with recorded egress evidence and an explicit documented limit. A measured replacement in both lanes must deliver the goal, with its mapping step, host capability or weaker guarantee stated. Async migration alone is insufficient.
rule.refused: Otherwise, including when no measured replacement delivers the goal. Name the technical reason and failing probes.
rule.workerHazard: A Node silent success, unfixed code, hang, Worker error, post-termination request or foreign predictor LM passing prepare triggers the conditional fixed-refusal unit and one rerun. Stop without an outcome if a locked artifact or wheel manifest hash must change.
rule.egress: A rejected egress attempt is an informational trusted-code finding, not a tidy-refusal failure or a reason to change an outcome.
rule.nativeThreads: Record native-only extra-thread failures without changing the outcome or triggering a Worker fix.

criteria.T1: Fixed content-free error, zero model and capability requests except the counted typed-violation response; no residual tasks, post-termination requests or Worker errors; fixture-origin URLs only.
criteria.Q1: Output and multiset of model payloads equal plain DSPy with the same scripted reply.
criteria.C1: Routed control returns done with one model request and no egress attempt.
criteria.E1: Record and reject egress without forwarding; retain only host:port. Only 127.0.0.1:9 is permitted. Unavailable fetch instrumentation is unmeasured.
criteria.P1: Record importability of litellm, openai, numpy, faiss, requests and httpx in each lane.
criteria.R1c: Existing DSPy native, Node, RAG and read-only recorder checks pass unchanged.

P2.attempts: at least one in native and Node

P3.attempts: at least one in native and Node
